common.name: Name

assets.description: Every asset is one thing with its own code and QR: where it is, who holds it, its status. Pick a place to see everything in it and below it.
assets.countHint: Identical ones bought together; each gets its own code.
assets.noDepreciation: Depreciation needs a cost, a purchase date and a useful life.
assets.linesHint: Add each item found in the place with its count; every asset gets its own code and QR.
assets.purchaseHint: Applies to every asset registered here.
assets.inServiceHint: Depreciation starts then; left empty, at the purchase date.
assets.deleteDraftConfirm: The draft will be deleted for good. Continue?
assets.draftNote: Draft: no code, movement or depreciation until approved.

move.title: Move
move.hint: Where it came from is kept in its movements.

assign.title: Hand over
assign.hint: To an employee, a member or a company. The asset must be in service and held by no one.

status.title: Change status
status.hint: In service, retired or lost. Maintenance and disposal have their own actions.

maintenance.title: Open maintenance
maintenance.hint: The asset stays in maintenance until it is closed: no custody, no disposal.

close.title: Close maintenance
close.hint: The asset returns to service, and a scheduled servicing moves on to its next date.

dispose.title: Dispose
dispose.hint: Final: the asset becomes read only. It must be back from custody and out of maintenance.

maintenance.pageDescription: What needs looking after: servicing coming due, and the repairs and servicing on record. A row opens its asset.

custody.description: Who holds what: every asset in someone's custody, or everything one employee, member or company holds (what an employee leaving hands back).

stock.description: Consumables: what is on hand where and its value at average cost, and the ledger every quantity is counted from.
stock.unitCostCountHint: For stock found beyond the book only; otherwise the average cost.

receive.title: Receive
receive.hint: A unit cost re-averages the cost at this place.

issue.title: Issue
issue.hint: Internal use, damaged or expired. Sales and plan consumption issue on their own.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.hint: What arrives keeps the cost it left at.

count.title: Count
count.hint: The balance becomes what was counted; the difference is recorded as an adjustment.

items.description: The catalog's items: how many assets each has, or how much is on hand for stock. An item with history is deactivated, not deleted.
items.propertiesHint: The fields of its category and the ones above it.

catalog.description: The category tree: a branch is either assets or stock, and each category has fields its items, and those below it, answer. And the units items are counted in.
catalog.pick: Pick a category to see its fields.
catalog.confirmDelete: Delete this category? It must be empty.
catalog.kindHint: Assets tracked one by one, or stock counted by quantity.
catalog.showToMembersHint: Its assets in service show to members in a space's details (a projector, two mics).
catalog.intangibleHint: Assets with no body (a software licence): no place or maintenance, amortized on a straight line.

fields.description: The fields this category's items answer, inherited ones included.
fields.label: Field
fields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and _; fixed once created.
fields.confirmDelete: Delete this field? Answers items gave stay stored.

reports.description: Stock on hand at average cost per place, and every asset with its book value today, totalled per currency.

warehouses.description: Where stock is kept, who is responsible for it, which items it may hold and whether reception may sell from it.
warehouses.dialogHint: Set its details and which items it may hold.
warehouses.search: Search by warehouse name, code or address…
warehouses.name: Warehouse
warehouses.locationUrlPlaceholder: Map link or how to get there
warehouses.notesPlaceholder: Anything staff should know about this warehouse…
warehouses.primaryHint: Reception takes stock from it by default. Needs a branch and sales allowed.
warehouses.scopeSearch: Search by item name or code…
warehouses.allowsSalesHint: Lets reception use it as a source for sales.

minimums.title: Minimum quantities
minimums.description: The least this warehouse should hold of each item. An item that falls below it is flagged. A minimum of 0 removes the row.

operations.pickHint: Choose the kind of movement to open its form.

transfer.title: Transfer between warehouses
transfer.hint: Move one or several items between two warehouses

adjust.title: Count adjustment
adjust.hint: Correct an item's balance up or down to what was counted

writeOff.title: Write-off
writeOff.hint: Take damaged or expired items out of the warehouse

receive.title: Manual receipt
receive.hint: Bring in goods from outside the purchasing cycle

issue.title: Manual issue
issue.hint: Take goods out for internal use

operations.scan: Scan or type a barcode, then Enter
operations.notStock: This item is an asset, not stock.
operations.pageHint: The movement is recorded as soon as you save it and changes the balance right away.

reasonText.transfer: Reason for the transfer or notes

linesHint.fromStock: Only items with stock in the chosen warehouse are listed.
linesHint.average: Cost follows each item’s current weighted average in the warehouse.
linesHint.entered: Enter each item’s unit cost; it is used in the weighted average.
linesHint.adjust: Enter what was counted; the difference from the book is recorded.

operations.attachmentHint: Images or PDF only, up to 2 MB.
operations.attachmentTooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB.
operations.attachmentType: Only images or a PDF can be attached.
operations.leaveBody: It has not been recorded; what you entered will be lost.

itemExtras.barcodeHint: Use the supplier's barcode or your own code. It must be unique.
itemExtras.barcodePlaceholder: Type a barcode or generate one
itemExtras.otherUnitsHint: The factor is how many main units are inside this unit. Example: box = 6 main units.
itemExtras.searchHint: Search by name, code or barcode
itemExtras.codeOptional: Leave it empty to have it generated. It cannot change after saving.
itemExtras.codeFixed: The code is fixed once saved.

settings.description: Set when the warehouses are first used; they override the config file. What recorded data depends on is locked, with its reason.
settings.loadError: The settings could not be loaded.

items_sku_mode.label: Who sets an item's code
items_sku_mode.hint: Always numbered, typed when made then fixed, or typed and changed at any time.

items_sku_prefix.label: Item code characters
items_sku_prefix.hint: Put before the running number, like ITM- in ITM-00001.

items_sku_pad.label: Number of digits
items_sku_pad.hint: The number is padded with zeros to this many digits.

assets_code_prefix.label: Asset code characters
assets_code_prefix.hint: Put before the asset's number, like AST- in AST-000001.

assets_store_in_warehouses.label: Store assets in warehouses
assets_store_in_warehouses.hint: An asset is received in a warehouse before it is handed to where it is used.

assets_max_batch.label: Most identical assets in one registration

assets_max_lines.label: Most items in one place's registration

stock_currency.label: Stock cost currency
stock_currency.hint: Stock is costed in it at weighted average cost.

assets_drafts.label: Register assets as drafts, then approve
assets_drafts.hint: An asset stays a draft until someone allowed to approve does so.

assets_intangible.label: Intangible assets
assets_intangible.hint: Allows asset categories with no place (software licences), amortized on a straight line.

assets_capital_additions.label: Capital additions
assets_capital_additions.hint: Money spent on an asset that raises its cost, depreciated over what is left of its life.

assets_depreciation_methods.label: Depreciation methods on offer
assets_depreciation_methods.hint: The first is the default for a new asset.

settings.optionsInUse: The dimmed choices are used by registered assets and cannot be removed.

additions.title: Capital additions
additions.removeConfirm: This addition will be removed and depreciation recalculated. Continue?
additions.hint: They raise the asset's cost and are depreciated over what is left of its life.
